category.description: dsl = Python/DSL for writing kernels; compiler-framework = full stack from graph to machine code; template-library = C++ templates for kernel composition; graph-optimizer = graph-level transformations only; kernel-dsl = low-level kernel DSL; runtime = execution runtime with built-in optimizations

target_backends.description: cuda | rocm | hip | metal | vulkan | cpu-avx512 | cpu-avx2 | opencl | tpu | xnnpack | spirv | webgpu

input_languages.description: python | jax | pytorch | tensorflow | onnx | tflite | cutlass-cpp | triton | mlir | xla-hlo

output_artifacts.description: ptx | amdgcn | spirv | air | metal | c | llvm-ir | triton-ir | cubin | plan

compilation_strategy.description: jit = just-in-time at runtime; aot = ahead-of-time; template-instantiation = C++ template expansion; graph-rewrite = graph-level transformations; mixed = multiple strategies

production_ready.description: True if used in production inference engines

production_evidence.description: Engine names or projects that use this in production

compile_time_seconds.description: Typical compile time for a single kernel, if known

sources.description: source ids; each must exist in data/sources/
